title: Underived finite etale reverse adjunction on pro-etale module sheaves
statement: Let $e:V\to X$ be a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism, def-weil-etale-morphism], and let $R$ be any commutative ring. On the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $e_*$ denote direct image on sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-proetale-module-direct-image, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $e^*$ denote inverse image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. There exists an adjunction $e_*\dashv e^*$. This assertion concerns the abelian sheaf categories, not derived categories. No finite coefficient, characteristic, invertibility, surjectivity, quasi-compactness, finite-type, or boundedness hypothesis is imposed beyond finite etaleness of $e$.

source.place: Proof, first two paragraphs, ending before passage to complexes; the finite sum/product argument for the sheaf-level adjunction.

proof.text: Use the natural isomorphism of sheafified localization extension with direct image [lem-sf-finite-etale-proetale-localization-comparison]. The actual left-Kan-extension/sheafification adjunction gives extension left adjoint to restriction. Transport its left functor along the comparison. Since e is weakly etale, upperStarIsoLocalizationRestriction identifies inverse image with restriction, by uniqueness of left adjoints to the existing direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Transport the right functor along the inverse of this isomorphism. The resulting adjunction is e_* left adjoint to e^*.

theorem finiteEtale_reverseModuleAdjunction {V X : Scheme.{u}} (e : V ⟶ X)
    [IsFinite e] [Etale e] (R : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing R] :
    Nonempty (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) e ⊣ upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} R) e)
